description: End-to-end Jacobian d u(T) / d v0 after 100 XLB steps or 20 shared surrogate macro-steps, restricted to the complete real divergence-free Fourier recovery subspace with |k| <= 4. Both the total Jacobian and the nonlinear residual after subtracting the shared full-horizon viscous-diffusion baseline are reported.

conventions.subspace: All sine/cosine modes through |k| <= 4 with both transverse polarizations; constant mean and longitudinal modes excluded.
